title: Removed reverse outpost reappears after an initial build refusal
detail: An initially build-refused reverse outpost can reappear in the home list after a user removes it. Enrollment persisted on the fixture outpost, but its next background connection still runs the initial-join lifecycle and recreates the removed row. Correct the transition so an already-recorded enrollment follows reconnect semantics even after a build refusal. Independently confirmed and measured with fixture daemons. See review s-2ptbz8.
